description: Sign a WebAuthn sign-in, as an authenticator does for navigator.credentials.get(): authenticator data and an ES256 signature over it and the client data's hash, with the vault's passkey for the site, plus the credential id and user handle a browser returns. With allow_credentials, only a passkey those ids name; without (a discoverable request), any discoverable passkey for the RP ID. When several can answer, the call is refused as several with the candidates: call again with credential_id. No passkey for the site is refused as no_credential. Hand the result only to the page that asked; the key never leaves this server.

allow_credentials.description: The request's allowCredentials ids; empty for a discoverable request.

items.description: A credential id, base64url as WebAuthn's JSON carries it.

client_data_hash.description: SHA-256 of the client data JSON the browser (or the program in its place) built for this request, base64url (43 characters).

credential_id.description: The passkey to sign with, from an earlier answer's candidates or list_passkeys.

rp_id.description: The RP ID: the site's domain the passkey is bound to, e.g. example.com or login.example.com.

user_verified.description: Whether the user was verified for this request, which sets the UV flag. True only when the caller verified them: an agent signing in as its own identity, or a person who approved the request.

name: assert_passkey
title: Sign in with a passkey
